description: Doccano sequence-labeling export: NER span annotations on DDB title strings

dummy.doccano.jsonl.description: Unannotated base file used for Doccano import; no labels

id.description: Document ID (1-indexed); matches source document ID

text.description: Raw title string from the DDB record; UTF-8

label.description: List of span annotations; empty array when unannotated

fields.name: end
fields.description: End character offset (exclusive); Python slice semantics: text[start:end]

Comments.description: Annotator free-text remarks; empty array when none

label_types.TITLE: Main title of the work
label_types.PERSON: Personal name (author, creator, or attributed person)

span_convention: Character offsets into text; start inclusive, end exclusive (Python text[start:end])
